item.title: Trump meets with top tech leaders to discuss regulations and launch new website
item.description: President Trump met with top tech leaders Tuesday as he rolled out an AI-driven website, America.gov, to help citizens navigate government services.
item.content:encoded: President Trump met with top tech leaders Tuesday as he rolled out an AI-driven website, America.gov, to help citizens navigate government services.

item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with AI policy expert Aalok Mehta about President Trump's AI Summit with tech industry leaders.

item.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
item.description: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

item.title: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
item.description: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development
item.description: President Trump on Tuesday said that he and a large group of leaders of artificial intelligence companies had signed a voluntary accord that will include internal and external reviews.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump hosts tech executives as administration doubles down on AI
item.description: President Trump met with AI CEOs at the White House on Tuesday and promoted a new government AI tool even as concerns about the technology's risks grow.

item.title: OpenAI stops training latests models, citing safety concerns
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with AI security expert Helen Toner about OpenAI's decision to halt training of its latest models, after discovering more instances of its agents behaving unexpectedly.

item.title: OpenAI delays latest model over security concerns, as industry faces pressure
item.description: OpenAI's decision to hold back the model, called GPT-6.1 Astra, comes amid a broader push within the industry to slow the development of increasingly autonomous systems until safety measures catch up.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: AI has sparked anxiety, earlier generations showed us ways to manage our fears
item.description: Much of what we are hearing about AI leaves many people anxious about the risks posed by the technology. The writer Michael Sacacas takes a long view of how to manage such feelings.

item.title: Chatbots are becoming a new reality for renters
item.description: Landlords are using AI chatbots to manage interactions with their tenants. We hear from one renter who just wants help from a human.
